name: Ama Ama ★ Sharing
original_name: あまあま★シェアリング
source:
Between a tedious daily commute to school and enrolling in an academy way out of my league, I’m pretty much always stressed out. Academically, my grades are dead average. I suck at sports, and as for my looks... well, I’m definitely not confident in them.

For someone as unremarkable as me, my only real source of pride was my two cousins.

First, there's Ashino Koyomi, our student council president. Blessed with both brains and beauty, she exudes the graceful charm of a traditional [i]yamato nadeshiko[/i]. She’s got a massive following, making her the undisputed most popular girl among the guys at school.

Next is Ashino Karen, Koyomi's younger sister. Her personality is... the complete opposite of Koyomi’s. She's high-energy, direct, and always moving around. With her outstanding athletic talent, she’s also popular among the girls at school.

Having the two of them as my cousins was my one quiet pride, and I was genuinely happy that they still treated me the same way they did when we were kids. Still, to avoid drawing the jealous wrath from the student body, I made sure to keep my distance on campus as much as possible…

Until that fate-altering day...

[From the [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/p-ex/project/as/highlight.html]official website[/url]]
